description: Per-segment trajectory plan emitted by the wadachi motion_control Pregel cell. References a parent deliveryRoute and provides the 10 Hz control points the vehicle will follow (G6 trajectory determinism — same inputs MUST reproduce the same trajectory). The plan is the artifact that motion_control commits BEFORE executing motion, so a post-incident replay can verify the executed trajectory matched the plan. Per ADR-2605242000 + gates G6 (determinism @10Hz), G3 (safety witness pre-attestation can be required before high-speed segments), G4 (obstacle map version locked at planning time).

trajectoryPlanId.description: Stable identifier for this trajectory plan. Cited by missionCompleteRecord.trajectoryPlanIds.

deliveryRouteId.description: Parent route this plan implements a segment of.

vehicleDid.description: DID of the vehicle that will execute this trajectory.

segmentIndex.description: Zero-based index of this segment within the parent route's waypoint list.

controlPointCadenceHz.description: G6 constitutional invariant: trajectory determinism MUST be at 10 Hz.

controlPoints.description: Ordered control points at 10 Hz cadence.

maxSpeedMmps.description: Maximum commanded speed in mm/s (m/s × 1000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

obstacleMapVersionCid.description: G4: IPFS CID of the obstacle map version frozen at planning time. Avoidance decisions during execution reference THIS version, not any later one.

determinismHash.description: G6 reproducibility key — sha256 over (route inputs + obstacle map + planner config). Replay with same inputs MUST produce same hash.

motionControlCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the motion_control cell's compute attestation that produced this trajectory.

preExecutionSafetyWitnessSignature.description: Optional G3 pre-attestation for high-speed (>30 km/h) or restricted-area segments. Required for some vehicle classes.

tOffsetMs.description: Milliseconds offset from segment start; at 10 Hz cadence MUST be a multiple of 100.

xMm.description: Local-frame X position in millimeters (meters × 1000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

headingMrad.description: Heading in milliradians (rad × 1000) from local-frame X axis. Range [-π, π] × 1000 ≈ [-3142, 3142].

speedMmps.description: Commanded speed at this point in mm/s (m/s × 1000).
